title: dimensionality_reduction
description: Run calculations that output information required for most integration methods: PCA, nearest neighbour and UMAP.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `dataset.h5mu`

layer.description: use specified layer for expression values instead of the .X object from the modality.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output.h5mu`

obsm_pca.description: In which .obsm slot to store the resulting PCA embedding.

var_pca_feature_selection.description: Column name in .var matrix that will be used to select which genes to run the PCA on.

pca_loadings_varm_output.description: Name of the .varm key where the PCA loadings are stored.

pca_variance_uns_output.description:
Name of the .uns key where the variance and variance ratio will be stored as a map.
The map will contain two keys: variance and variance_ratio respectively.

pca_overwrite.description: Allow overwriting slots for PCA output.

uns_neighbors.description: In which .uns slot to store various neighbor output objects.

obsp_neighbor_distances.description: In which .obsp slot to store the distance matrix between the resulting neighbors.

obsp_neighbor_connectivities.description: In which .obsp slot to store the connectivities matrix between the resulting neighbors.

obsm_umap.description: In which .obsm slot to store the resulting UMAP embedding.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
